title: Cunha goal allowed after Mbeumo trapped the ball with his arm
summary: Bryan Mbeumo trapped Diogo Dalot's cross between his arm and hip before Matheus Cunha scored. VAR correctly sent referee Michael Salisbury to the monitor, but he kept the goal, calling the handball accidental. PGMOL admitted the next day that the goal should not have stood. It was worth two points to United.
consequences: Howard Webb spoke to both Forest and United to acknowledge the misjudgement.

reactions.quote: After review, the decision of goal stands because the handball offence is accidental, therefore the final decision is goal.
